description: This Python module provides authentication and authorization utilities for a FastAPI backend, specifically for integrating with Supabase. It includes functions to validate JWT tokens, retrieve user roles from the database, define role-based access dependencies, and manage user context data.

classes.name: UserContext
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing the authenticated user's identity and role, including user ID, email, role, and access token.

methods.name: tuple[str,str] _require_supabase_env()
methods.description: Retrieves the SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variables, raising errors if they are not set.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_supabase_user(access_token: str)
methods.description: Validates the provided access token by querying the Supabase Auth API and returning the user payload.

methods.name: str _get_user_role( *, user_id: UUID, access_token: str, supabase: SupabaseRestClient, )
methods.description: Fetches the user's role from the 'profiles' table based on user ID and access token, defaulting to 'customer' if not found.

methods.name: str _parse_bearer_token(authorization: Optional[str])
methods.description: Extracts the bearer token from the Authorization header, raising an error if the format is invalid.

methods.name: require_roles(allowed_roles: Sequence[str])
methods.description: Creates a dependency that enforces that the current user has one of the specified roles.

methods.name: UserContext get_current_user(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency; validates the JWT token from the Authorization header, retrieves user info and role, and returns a UserContext.

methods.name: UserContext require_authenticated(user: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that ensures any authenticated user.

methods.name: UserContext require_admin(user: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that restricts access to users with the 'admin' role.

methods.name: UserContext require_technician_or_admin(user: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency allowing users with 'technician' or 'admin' roles.

ctags.name: _get_user_role
ctags.signature: ( *, user_id: UUID, access_token: str, supabase: SupabaseRestClient, )

ctags.name: access_token
ctags.pattern: /^    access_token: str = Field(..., description="Raw Supabase access token (JWT).")$/

ctags.name: email
ctags.pattern: /^    email: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="User email from Supabase auth.")$/

ctags.name: role
ctags.pattern: /^    role: str = Field(..., description="Application role: customer, technician, admin.")$/

ctags.name: user_id
ctags.pattern: /^    user_id: UUID = Field(..., description="Supabase auth user id (auth.users.id).")$/
